key.name: video-path
key.description: Absolute path to the video file used for the wallpaper and/or screensaver.

key.name: wallpaper-enabled
key.description: Play the video on loop as the desktop background. X11 only.

key.name: screensaver-enabled
key.description: Play the video fullscreen after the idle timeout elapses.

key.name: idle-seconds
key.description: How many seconds of inactivity before the screensaver starts.

key.name: dismiss-poll-ms
key.description: How often the extension checks for activity to dismiss the screensaver.
